cover.headline_html: 3 myths keeping small businesses out of federal.

myths.label: The Past-Performance Trap
myths.myth_text: You need federal past performance before you can win anything.
myths.reality_text: Teaming agreements let new entrants piggyback on a prime's record. You can sub on day one, build a real track record, and bid as a prime within 2–3 years.

myths.label: The Schedule Sells Itself
myths.myth_text: Once you get a GSA Schedule, agencies will find you and award you work.
myths.reality_text: The Schedule is access — not a sales engine. You still need to market, respond to RFQs, and follow up. Holders who go passive almost always end up with zero awards.

myths.label: The Cost Myth
myths.myth_text: Getting a GSA Schedule costs more than a small business can afford.
myths.reality_text: There's no application fee. The real cost is 100+ hours of paperwork — or hiring someone to handle it. Most holders recoup that investment on their first award.

close.close_question: Drop the belief that almost kept you from pursuing federal contracting.
